+"""Directed residual-direction alignment with rigid nearest-code assignments."""
+
+import torch
+

+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute masked directed alignment; argmin assignments are intentionally discrete."""
+    eps = parameters.get("eps", 1e-8)
+    rho = parameters.get("rho", 0.2)
+    weight = parameters.get("weight", 0.01)
+    source_index = torch.cdist(source.detach(), codebook.detach()).argmin(dim=-1)
+    target_index = torch.cdist(target.detach(), codebook.detach()).argmin(dim=-1)
+    source_residual = source - codebook[source_index]
+    target_residual = target - codebook[target_index]
+    u = source_residual / source_residual.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(eps)
+    v = target_residual / target_residual.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(eps)
+    # The signed source-minus-target norm correction makes source/target roles explicit.
+    per_pair = 1.0 - (u * v).sum(dim=-1) + rho * (
+        (u * u).sum(dim=-1) - (v * v).sum(dim=-1)
+    )
+    mask = mask.to(device=per_pair.device, dtype=per_pair.dtype)
+    return weight * (per_pair * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp_min(1.0)

+"""Directed residual-direction alignment with rigid nearest-code assignments."""
+
+import torch
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute masked directed alignment; argmin assignments are intentionally discrete."""
+    eps = parameters.get("eps", 1e-8)
+    rho = parameters.get("rho", 0.2)
+    weight = parameters.get("weight", 0.01)
+    source_index = torch.cdist(source.detach(), codebook.detach()).argmin(dim=-1)
+    target_index = torch.cdist(target.detach(), codebook.detach()).argmin(dim=-1)
+    source_residual = source - codebook[source_index]
+    target_residual = target - codebook[target_index]
+    u = source_residual / source_residual.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(eps)
+    v = target_residual / target_residual.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(eps)
+    # The signed source-minus-target norm correction makes source/target roles explicit.
+    per_pair = 1.0 - (u * v).sum(dim=-1) + rho * (
+        (u * u).sum(dim=-1) - (v * v).sum(dim=-1)
+    )
+    mask = mask.to(device=per_pair.device, dtype=per_pair.dtype)
+    return weight * (per_pair * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp_min(1.0)
